name: seoseo-a2a-closeout
summary: Executable guard rules promoted from Seoseo A2A/A2AD closeout skills.

commands.name: manifest
commands.purpose: Validate A2AD source-only and GitHub patch task-shape boundaries before dispatch, including raw artifact/sourceBundle caps.
sourceSkillRules: formal A2A must use broker-backed evidence, not generic delegation
source-only A2AD lanes use intent=analyze and payload.mode=analysis-only
GitHub patch lanes use intent=propose_patch and payload.mode=github-propose-patch
large raw artifacts must be bounded or summarized before model-visible injection

commands.name: formal-evidence
commands.purpose: Fail closed finalizer drafts that claim quorum/consensus without terminal substantive task evidence, and flag protected-baseline verifier regression.

commands.name: repo-sweep-closeout
commands.purpose: Require live open issue/PR inventory to reach zero before declaring a repo sweep closed.

commands.name: pr-body-boundary
commands.purpose: Prevent PR-only/live-validation boundary violations such as closure keywords or claimed deploy/restart/ACK effects.

commands.name: scorecard
commands.purpose: Classify worker evidence so infra/wrapper/source-projection failures do not count as substantive worker output, and report cost per accepted substantive change.
